    Class XernerxCommands

    @xernerx/framework extension that registers Jishaku-inspired developer commands (xc!, evaluate, shell, git, source, haste, ping, debug, repeat, su, transpile, documentation) and synchronizes slash/context commands with the Xernerx Suite API.

    Example

    import { XernerxClient } from '@xernerx/framework';
    import { XernerxCommands } from '@xernerx/commands';

    export class Client extends XernerxClient {
    	constructor() {
    		super({
    			intents: ['Guilds', 'GuildMessages', 'MessageContent'],
    			token: process.env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN!,
    			owners: ['YOUR_USER_ID'],
    		});

    		this.modules.extensionHandler.loadExtensions(
    			new XernerxCommands(this, {
    				token: process.env.XERNERX_TOKEN!,
    				prefix: 'xc!',
    				useEmbeds: true,
    				cache: {
    					messages: 1000,
    				},
    			})
    		);

    		this.connect();
    	}
    }

    new Client();
